comment: Draft stand-ins for [[brackets]] on the site, used ONLY by scripts/drafts.mjs to build a throwaway preview. Nothing here is Conor's. Every draft exists so Jake and Conor can judge a finished layout; Conor replaces the words or strikes them. The real pages keep their brackets until he does.

drafts.draft: I sat at a desk in a bank that morning and sang Mercy on national television that night, with a drummer behind me for the first time in my life. No chair turned. I am still glad I walked out there. Adam told me to come back with an acoustic song, and that is exactly what I plan to do.
